facts.fact: Uganda's Ministry of ICT and National Guidance held a five-day ICDL-aligned digital skills training (Computer and Online Essentials, Digital Marketing) for communication officers from government MDAs, with further ICDL modules set for July 2025.
facts.system: MoICT&NG ICDL digital skills training for MDA communication officers

systems.owner: Ministry of ICT and National Guidance

UGA.note: Document does not state anything on a data protection law.
Training is for government communicators only, not the public.
Document states nothing on international standards bodies or adoption.
Document gives no internet usage figure.
Document states nothing on local government office connection.
Document states nothing on school internet or curriculum.
Document states nothing on startup law or funding.
Document names the National ICT Innovation Hub only as a venue, with no programme for startups stated.
